provenance.source_name: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year (2020-2024), county SDOH bundle
provenance.pending_reason: Requires CENSUS_API_KEY. build-data.yml runs refresh-acs-sdoh-county.mjs with the key set to populate real values.
provenance.notes: Each measure is numerator / (universe - not-computed cells) * 100 from Census-published county counts; the exact variables are listed per measure. Values are direct tabulations (VERIFIED). Margins of error are not propagated through the ratios; this payload carries estimates only. Negative Census sentinels (suppressed or unavailable estimates) become null, never zero. When status = 'pending-ci' the ingest environment lacked CENSUS_API_KEY or could not reach api.census.gov; build-data.yml re-runs this script with the key to populate. The broadband subscription file (acs-broadband-county) is a separate ingest and may sit on an older ACS window.
